violation_type.title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation (26 TAC §744.2103(b)(4))
violation_type.short_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation
violation_type.typical_finding: A caregiver was observed restraining a child and pulling the child out from under a cafeteria table by both legs.

finding_variants.text: A caregiver was observed restraining a child and pulling the child out from under a cafeteria table by both legs.
Three children were observed in time-out longer than the allowed time. This was corrected at inspection when then children were asked to join the group for the next activity.
